as_told.title: Levitating sphere in the Off-World Technology area
as_told.place_text: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana

plain: Randy Anderson, a man who says he worked at Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, a Navy research base in Indiana, says that around 2014 he was shown a metal sphere about the size of a basketball. He says it simply floated above a podium with nothing holding it up. In another telling he places it in an area he calls Off-World Technology and dates it only to the 2010s; if true, it would mean the military holds objects that defy ordinary physics.
